name: Reolink Doorbell
description: Live Reolink doorbell video with two-way audio via go2rtc/RTSP. Configure the stream URL from your Home Assistant go2rtc instance. No cloud service required.

settings.title: RTSP stream URL
settings.description: go2rtc RTSP URL for the doorbell stream, e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.10:8554/reolink_doorbell. Use rtsps:// for TLS.

settings.title: Image sizing
settings.description: Fit shows the whole picture; Fill crops to the screen; Stretch fills without preserving proportions.

settings.title: Viewport aspect
settings.description: Auto uses the full screen. Other values constrain the viewing area.

settings.title: Auto-close after inactivity
settings.description: Controls reset the timer. Talk suspends auto-close. Off keeps the viewer open.

settings.title: Enable two-way audio
settings.description: Tap the microphone to start/stop. Requires go2rtc RTSP backchannel support (configure reolink source in go2rtc.yaml). Green is off; red is active.

settings.title: Microphone auto-off (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum talk duration. Transmission stops automatically after this time.
